main_text.head: LXVII.

p.i: Num vtraque igitur, & verbum & Sacramenta eò spectant, vt fidem nostram ad sacrificium Christi in cruce peractum, tanquam ad vnicum nostræ salutis fundamentum deducant?

main_text.p: Ita est. Nam Spiritus sanctus docet Euangelio, & confirmat sacramentis, omnem nostram salutem positam esse in vnico sacrificio Christi, pro nobis in cruce oblatiRom. 6. v. 3. An ignoratis, nos quotquot baptizati sumus in Christum Iesum, in mortem eius esse baptizatos?.
Galat. 3. v. 26. 27. Omnes enim filij Dei estis, per fidem in Christo Iesu. Nam quicunque in Christo baptizati estis, Christum induistis.
main_text.head: LXVIII.
Quot Sacramenta instituit Christus in nouo fœdere?

page.notes: Marginal reference "Rom. 6. v.3." sits beside the first column's end at right; the Galatians passage is set as a column-part in the right column. Reference mark 4 follows "oblati" in the left column. Upper left text partly faint. Right column text placed as printed; the reference notes are given in place.
